name: python-traceback
summary: GET /raise makes the Python service call .strip() on a None field; the unhandled AttributeError prints a real Python traceback.
ground_truth: The Python service's /raise handler reads a field that is None and immediately calls .strip() on it, raising an unhandled AttributeError ('NoneType' object has no attribute 'strip'). The handler never catches it, so the interpreter prints a full Python traceback to stderr.
